shortDescription: Catcher Predict reported that the Toronto Blue Jays option in Polymarket’s Toronto Blue Jays vs. Kansas City Royals market surged from 45.5% one hour earlier to 93%, a 47.5 percentage point move. According to ChainCatcher, the sharp swing may reflect the impact of breaking news.
